crossRefs.note: “If my heart has been enticed to a woman, and I have laid wait at my neighbor’s door,
They are all adulterers. They are burning like an oven that the baker stops stirring, from the kneading of the dough…
So the tongue is also a little member, and boasts great things. See how a small fire can spread to a large forest!

translations.web: Can a man scoop fire into his lap, and his clothes not be burned?
translations.bsb: Can a man embrace fire and his clothes not be burned?
translations.kjv: Can a man take fire in his bosom, and his clothes not be burned?
translations.asv: Can a man take fire in his bosom, And his clothes not be burned?
